dish.note: Sticky honey and soy chicken drumsticks, eaten with your hands. Drum solo optional.
dish.how: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and coat the drumsticks. Roast on a lined tray at 200°C for 40 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and dark. Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion and serve with plenty of napkins.
dish.make_ahead: Coat the drumsticks in the glaze up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast just before serving

steps.text: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and coat the drumsticks.
Roast on a lined tray at 200°C, turning and basting twice, until sticky and dark.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion and serve with napkins.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead; glaze and roast on the night

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut in big florets

steps.text: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil and toss the florets in it.
Roast on a lined tray at 210°C, turning once, until sticky and charred at the edges.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

dish.vegNote: Sticky honey and soy roast cauliflower florets, eaten with your hands.
